messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Finish with "They inspired uneasy admiration." and don’t add anything after it. Avoid these punctuation characters entirely: ['!']. Write 6 paragraphs or more. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "=====".

Write a blog post about the sleek new magistrates. Use every punctuation mark in this list at least once: ['!', ',']. End your response with this exact line: "They raised uneasy admiration.". Avoid divider lines between paragraphs. Use at most 5 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.)
